command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=tetragon/observer BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=map_inline SAMPLES=1 WORKLOAD_DURATION=30 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image

derived_counts.note: Every derived value is computed from the retained details/loadtime-reports/tetragon__observer.jsonl stream and the retained per-step bytecode in details/loadtime-workdirs/. The paper's declared RQ2 4086 site count and Tetragon site figures are not merged with this fresh figure.

log_normalization: Guest-console carriage returns and trailing horizontal whitespace normalized in the retained copy.
scope: Fresh local KVM single-pass map_inline run for Tetragon only. It retains, for each of the 118 changed load instances, the per-step input and output bytecode plus the optimizer report, so the rewrite's before/after instruction counts and applied-site totals are derived rather than declared. It exercises the default map_inline policy (--map-values/--map-ids, no inline hints) over six distinct array maps (tg_conf_map, policy_conf, policy_stats, cgroup_rate_opt, .rodata, config_map) across kprobe, tracepoint, raw_tracepoint and socket_filter program types, with two- and three-site programs as well as single-site ones. It is a single startup with SAMPLES=1 and does not re-measure the paper's declared Tetragon site figures; the two are never merged.
